title: 第2章 白玩了人家儿媳妇-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “赵贵，你不是说李青山那二流子正在欺负你家儿媳妇吗？”

    “怎么，人呢？”

    李虎盯着床上的王乃香，心中闪过一抹贪婪，却面露怒色道：“把我们当猴耍是不是？”

    王乃香

    说罢。

    便上前一步，直接拎起赵贵的衣领，低声怒道：“怎么回事?”

    “这这这……！”

    “我也不知道啊！”

    “刚刚还在床上的。”

    赵贵是有苦说不出，李青山这二流子可是自己亲自扶上儿媳床的。

    “贱人，还睡呢……给我醒醒……！”

    赵贵的婆娘见状，抄起旁边的水盆便泼在醉醺醺的王乃香脸上。

    “啊……！”

    王乃香被激的一声尖叫，望着自己房间站满了人，一双美眸中满是疑惑，还未来得及反应，赵贵便挣脱了李虎的束缚，上前一步逼问道：“李青山呢？”

    “李青山？”

    “什么李青山？”

    王乃香更加疑惑了。

    “你个贱婊子还装，李青山明明在你床上的，人呢？”

    赵贵气急败坏之下，也不顾老脸，当着村民的面便破口大骂王乃香是贱婊子。

    “爹？”

    “你在胡说什么？李青山怎么会在我床上？”

    王乃香被公爹在这么多人面前骂贱婊子，心中顿时升起无尽的委屈，谁能受得了这份屈辱？

    “赵贵，你这话就有些过分了啊！”

    “就是，人家小媳妇在床上睡得好好的，什么时候偷汉子了？”

    “那二流子不会藏起来了吧？”

    村子里的李铁匠，豆腐张，桂花嫂子纷纷开口道。

    “什么偷汉子，那是李青山要强奸我家儿媳妇。”

    “对了，肯定是藏起来了。”

    “我得找找，不能白玩了我家儿媳妇，提上裤子就跑了。”

    赵贵感受到李虎那吃人的目光，连忙开始在柜子里，床洞下找了起来……！

    哎呦，这个该死的二流子。

    到底跑哪里去了？

    要是还不上赌债，自家儿子还在李虎手里呢，一只手肯定就要被这李虎砍断了。

    成了残废，这辈子可就完了。

    “呦，这么热闹，干嘛呢？”

    就在这时。
    第(1/3)页

"Zhao Gui, didn't you say that that second-rate Li Qingshan was bullying your daughter-in-law?"

"What, where is the person?"

Li Hu stared at Wang Naixiang on the bed, a flash of greed flashed in his heart, but he said with an angry expression: "Are you treating us like monkeys?"

Wang Naixiang



Then he took a step forward, picked up Zhao Gui's collar, and said angrily in a low voice: "What's going on?"

"This, this, this...!"

"I don't know either!"

"I was in bed just now."

"Zhao Gui couldn't tell the trouble, because Li Qingshan, a second-rate man, personally helped his daughter-in-law to bed.

"Bitch, you're still sleeping... wake up...!"

When Zhao Gui’s mother-in-law saw this, she picked up the basin next to her and poured it on the drunk Wang Naixiang’s face.

"Ah...!"

Wang Naixiang screamed in excitement, looking at her room full of people, her beautiful eyes full of doubts. Before she could react, Zhao Gui broke free from Li Hu's restraints, stepped forward and asked, "Where is Li Qingshan?"

"Li Qingshan?"

"What Li Qingshan?"

Wang Naixiang became even more confused.

"You bitch, you are still pretending that Li Qingshan is clearly in your bed, where is he?"

Zhao Gui was so angry that he ignored his old face and cursed Wang Naixiang as a bitch in front of the villagers.

"Dad?"

"What are you talking about? Why is Li Qingshan in my bed?"

Wang Naixiang was called a bitch by her father-in-law in front of so many people, and endless grievances suddenly arose in her heart. Who can bear this humiliation?

"Zhao Gui, what you said is a bit too much!"

"That's right, my little wife is sleeping well in bed. When did she steal a man?"

"The second-rate guy won't be hiding, will he?"

“Tiejiang Li, Tofu Zhang and Sister-in-law Guihua all spoke one after another in the village.

"What a thief, it's Li Qingshan who wants to rape my daughter-in-law."

"By the way, it must be hidden."

"I have to look for it. I can't let my daughter-in-law pick up her pants and run away in vain."

Zhao Gui felt Li Hu’s cannibalistic gaze and quickly started searching in the cupboard and under the bed...!

“Ouch, this damn second-rate guy.

Where did you go?

“If the gambling debts are not repaid and my son is still in Li Hu’s hands, one of his hands will definitely be chopped off by Li Hu.

If you become disabled, your life will be over.

"Hey, it's so lively, what are you doing?"

At this moment.
